name: MIREX Beat Tracking Evaluation
description: An MIREX benchmark for evaluating automatic beat tracking systems, measuring how accurately a system predicts musical beat positions and tempo structure.
evaluation_method: Beat-level precision/recall, continuity-based scores, and alignment/tolerance-based metrics used by the MIREX evaluation protocol.
notes: MIREX evaluations are community standard but the exact dataset and scoring protocol can vary by year. Beat tracking is sensitive to metrical ambiguity and annotation tolerance.

institutions: International Music Information Retrieval Systems Evaluation Laboratory (MIREX)
